charge_port.notes: InsideEVs: all 2027 Silverado EV models come from the factory with a native NACS port. Also GM says all 2027 EVs get native NACS (Electrek 2026-08-14). US only.

supercharger_access.notes: InsideEVs: the native NACS port lets the 2027 Silverado EV use Tesla Superchargers and other NACS chargers without an adapter. Electrek 2026-08-14 adds that some Supercharger sites stay Tesla-only. US only.

wheels.notes: No 2027 page on Cars.com; 18 in carried from the 2026 Work Truck pages.
